name: linux-feature-migration
title: Complete Linux feature migration
description: Migrate all remaining eu4dll functionality to the canonical refactored Linux x86-64 target in independently verifiable vertical slices, using the legacy Linux port as binary/ABI evidence rather than a codebase to merge.
scope: Linux text layout, UI text, tooltip/button text, UTF-8 localization, map text, text3D, input/IME, clipboard paste, pinyin/search, save-file naming, final parity and stability
creator: charl
notes: Prerequisite: 09-05-linux-port-foundation must remain stable. Migrate facts, not the legacy framework. Keep each feature independently gateable during migration; mapText is a dedicated high-risk stage.
